description: a 4 × 4 plate 1 thick with a spherical dimple cut into its top, the sphere of radius 1 about (2, 2, 1.5), written by Open CASCADE with every closed edge split in two (ShapeUpgrade_ShapeDivideClosedEdges): the rim is two half circles of radius √3/2 between the top and the sphere, the sphere's seam at one vertex and nothing but the two arcs at the other (ADR-0041). One half of the rim filleted at r 0.1: a plane against a sphere centred on its axis, convex, the chain runs on through both vertices and closes as a whole ring, two half tori coaxial with the dimple. Open CASCADE builds the ring as one face

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE builds the blend of the ring (a plane's circle against a sphere) as one face spanning a whole turn, V/E/F/L 11/16/8/9, where Arris builds one face per arc and a junction arc and two vertices at each vertex of the split, 13/19/9/10 (ADR-0041); the part and the blend are the same solid, the measures and probes agree with the oracle's
analytic.step_differs: Open CASCADE's own STEP of the result carries its 11/16/8/9 where Arris's carries its 13/19/9/10, one whole-turn blend face against two halves (counts_differ)
